Game Overview

At its heart, Medieval Survival Extreme is a shooter game about survive relentless medieval battles. Start with a basic weapon, upgrade your arsenal, and face endless enemy hordes. Strategize to defeat formidable bosses and carve your path to freedom in this dynamic survival challenge. Can you escape the chaos?
